mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND email = #{email}
SELECT id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, name, email, status FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, name, email, status FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
